record.title: Rishtan–Sokh restriction following disputed August 2019 reopening
record.scope: Route connecting Uzbekistan’s mainland to Sokh exclave through Kyrgyzstan
record.crossings: Rishtan–Kaytpas route to Sokh; Tul–Otukchu ceremony/nonoperation reporting. Lenburg–Apkan claimed open by Uzbek Border Troops but operation disputed.
record.imposing_authority: Kyrgyz border regime; Uzbek PM attributed closure to an EAEU request
record.enforcement: Contemporary local reporting describes an inoperative post after the ceremony; official accounts disagree whether traffic briefly resumed.
record.relationship: Preserves CC026 stable ID while qualifying its 2019 phase boundary. Do not add a separate 2013–2019 episode until actual 2019 resumption is resolved. Round10 retains held R9-AS-001/R8-AS-L001; Tul–Otukchu and Lenburg–Apkan must not be silently equated.
record.status_observation: Formal reopening ceremony documented April 1, 2021; ordinary operational restart not independently observed.
record.official_rationale: Kyrgyz deputy PM cited unresolved EAEU veterinary/phytosanitary obligations; Uzbek PM later attributed renewed closure to an EAEU request. No EAEU instrument retrieved.
record.context: August 2019 ceremony may mark a failed reopening or a brief opening followed by reclosure. Earlier closure is reported from 2013; this stable record tracks the disputed 2019 policy phase.
record.uncertainty: Whether the August 2019 ceremony produced an operational opening is disputed. Month-level date marks the documented renewed/continued restriction phase, not a proven new first closure. April 1, 2021 is ceremony/permission; no uniform interval or separate inherited phase is inferred. September1 Uzbek Border Troops claim lists Lenburg–Apkan among operating pairs; September7 field report says preparations shifted from Lenbur–Apkan to Tul and the ceremonially opened post remained closed. These sources do not establish Apkan operation or a separate inherited-phase endpoint.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established

Ceremony versus actual closure conflict prevents a continuous-duration calculation.
